digest.component_or_area: rebar init CLI and store initialization
propositions: rebar init silently creates an empty orphan branch when the configured tickets branch cannot be fetched due to network failure or timeout, instead of failing closed.
The current implementation checks only local refs and local remote-tracking refs; a failed fetch makes an existing remote branch indistinguishable from a genuine first init.

Multiple code paths (_mount_or_create_branch, pending_init_attaches_to_existing, ensure_store_mounted_best_effort, _create_tracker) must share a single tri-state remote-branch probe (advertised, reachable-absent, unreachable) to consistently distinguish these cases.
When the remote is unreachable or times out, init must fail with actionable diagnostics instead of orphaning, unless explicitly overridden via --force-new-store flag.

ensure_store_mounted_best_effort must treat unreachable remotes as do-not-auto-mount and return without error; the following strict init path then reuses the cached probe result and reports the failure.
